pairs.evidence: prototype/shared/shell.js:22 The owner's variant picks and the page list are written out separately in shell.js (PAGES/CHOSEN, lines 13-22) and build-index.mjs (PAGES/CHOSEN, lines 15-31), and the two copies have already drifted (build-index has home: 3, shell.js has no home entry), so every new verdict means two edits and one of them gets missed.

techniques.evidence: prototype/shared/shell.js:22 Same decision (chosen variant per page) also at build-index.mjs:31 `const CHOSEN = { home: 3, deal: 1, ...`; things that change together live apart and have already diverged.
